rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An autonomous penetration testing framework built for CTF competitions and security research, originating from a Tencent Security Hackathon. Uses Claude API to drive multi-agent workflows and exposes MCP tool bridges for Kali Linux Docker container management, command execution, and optional C2 tool integrations. Includes a web dashboard for monitoring agent progress and security documentation for responsible use in controlled lab environments.
